title: Adventure awaits with a free preview of Outdoor and Sportsman channels
summary: From Sept. 28 through Oct. 31, TDS TV+ customers can enjoy a free preview of Outdoor Channel and Sportsman Channel,… more...
body_markdown:
From **Sept.** **28 through Oct.** **31** , TDS TV+ customers can enjoy a free preview of Outdoor Channel and Sportsman Channel, two networks packed with hunting, fishing, shooting sports and outdoor adventure programming.


Whether you’re planning your next outdoor excursion or enjoy watching thrilling adventures unfold from the comfort of your home, this free preview offers something for every outdoor enthusiast.


**Outdoor Channel** is the premier destination for real-life outdoor action and adventure programming. Available around the clock, viewers can follow epic hunting and fishing trips, outdoor expeditions, heart-pounding adventures on land and water, and engaging personalities who live and breathe the outdoors lifestyle. The network also highlights the importance of resource conservation and land stewardship, while taking audiences on unforgettable journeys across the globe.


**Sportsman Channel** is the home of the authentic American sportsman, featuring entertaining and educational programming focused on hunting, fishing, and shooting sports. Through authentic hosts, expert instruction, and compelling storytelling, the network helps viewers sharpen their skills and celebrate the traditions that have connected generations of outdoor enthusiasts.


Customers should check their channel location guide to find these channels. If you enjoy the free preview, consider upgrading your TV package to watch these outdoor favorites all year long. Customers in Arizona, Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina, and Utah can[click here](https://shop.hellotds.com/tv/tdstv-plus.html) for more information, while all other customers can[browse TV options here](https://tdstelecom.com/shop/tv/tdstv-plus.html) .
